in_process_synchronization.behavior: Acquires lock before claim and orchestrator execution; releases in finally block

inter_process_coordination.primitive: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction + UNIQUE(task_id, request_id)
inter_process_coordination.scope: All worker processes targeting the same investigation.db
inter_process_coordination.behavior: Guarantees exactly one process can successfully INSERT or claim the execution slot

optimistic_revision_validation.behavior: Rejects stale revision requests with HTTP 409 before invoking orchestrator

db_level_integrity_triggers.revision_monotonicity: Enforced by triggers preventing skipping or decrementing revision numbers
db_level_integrity_triggers.hash_chaining: Enforced by triggers validating parent_state_hash matches previous revision state_hash
db_level_integrity_triggers.immutable_history: Enforced by triggers forbidding UPDATE or DELETE on historical working state revisions
